content.title: About
content.content: Chocolate milk drink is a ready‑to‑drink beverage made from whole milk, cocoa mass, sugar, and sometimes added flavorings such as vanilla or sea salt. It has a sweet, creamy taste with a pronounced chocolate note and is usually served cold or slightly warmed.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The first commercial chocolate milk drink appeared in the United States in the early 1920s.
Cocoa content typically ranges from 2 % to 5 % of the total volume.
In some countries the drink is sold as a concentrate that is reconstituted with water or milk.
Chocolate milk is often used as a base for desserts, smoothies, and sauces.
In Russia its popularity grew after brands introduced organic milk and "clean" cocoa versions.

items.title: Source of calcium
items.content: Milk, the main ingredient, provides calcium essential for strong bones and teeth.

items.title: Rich in B‑vitamins
items.content: The drink contains riboflavin (B2) and B12, which support energy metabolism.

items.title: Contains antioxidants
items.content: Cocoa mass is high in flavonoids that help combat free radicals.

items.title: Mood‑enhancing
items.content: Theobromine and small amounts of caffeine in cocoa can boost alertness and improve mood.

items.title: Supports hydration
items.content: The water content of milk contributes to overall fluid balance.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: People lacking lactase may experience bloating, gas, or diarrhea after consumption.

items.title: High sugar content
items.content: Sweetened versions can contribute to weight gain and increase the risk of dental caries.

items.title: Cocoa allergy
items.content: Rarely, individuals may have an allergic reaction to cocoa components.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: A 250 ml serving contains roughly 150–200 kcal, which should be considered in a calorie‑controlled diet.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Chocolate milk drink can be enjoyed straight from the carton, added to coffee, blended into smoothies, or used as a base for milkshakes. If desired, gently warm it in the microwave, but avoid boiling to preserve flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the drink refrigerated at 1 °C–4 °C. Once opened, consume within 5–7 days. Do not freeze, as thawing may alter the texture.
